hItems.title: St Kilda
hItems.description: Played at least 1 game for the St Kilda Saints, or currently on their list.

hItems.title: 25+ DISPOSALS
hItems.subtitle: GAME
hItems.description: Collected 25 or more disposals in a single game (since 1965).

hItems.title: LESS THAN 20 GOALS
hItems.subtitle: CAREER
hItems.description: Kicked less than 20 goals over their career (including finals).

vItems.title: 150+ GAMES
vItems.subtitle: SAME CLUB
vItems.description: Played 150 or more games at VFL/AFL level for a single club. Can also have played games for other clubs (including finals).

vItems.title: JIMMY WEBSTER
vItems.subtitle: JIMMY WEBSTER TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Jimmy Webster.

vItems.title: BROTHER
vItems.subtitle: PLAYED
vItems.description: Has at least one brother who has played in the VFL/AFL.
